tolerance.note: The deterministic predictor is exactly reproducible for a given seed, so any change is a code or data change. A run fails the gate when, for any suite, F1 drops by more than f1_drop_abs (absolute, 0-1 scale) or mean human edits per case rise by more than edits_per_case_rise_abs. 0.02 F1 is ~1.4 mapping decisions on the hand-labeled set and ~0.25 edits/case is ~18 edits on the synthetic suite: small enough to catch real regressions, loose enough to allow deliberate trade-offs that are recorded by regenerating this file.
